description.value: Longwood is a locally owned craft brewpub and restaurant in Nanaimo, operating across multiple floors with a casual pub downstairs and a family-friendly restaurant above. The brewery produces award-winning core beers alongside rotating seasonal taps, all brewed on-site with an emphasis on local West Coast ingredients. A touring cyclist stopping here can expect a full sit-down meal, a wide menu including vegetarian and vegan options, and the option to pick up growlers or kegs to go.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms the business is an active, locally owned brew pub and restaurant at 5775 Turner Rd, Nanaimo. Phone and address match OSM exactly. The website name ('Longwood Brew Pub & Restaurant') differs in word order from the OSM name ('Longwood Restaurant and Brewpub') — flagged in concerns. The Brewer's Dining Room subpage explicitly lists free Wi-Fi as a feature; the food menu shows multiple vegetarian and vegan dishes; a Delivery service link and Kegs & Growlers to-go option indicate takeout is available. No evidence found for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or most other cycling-specific amenities.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records the business as 'Longwood Restaurant and Brewpub', but the website consistently uses 'Longwood Brew Pub & Restaurant' (word order reversed, formatting differs).

Website references a separate 'Longwood Brewery on Boxwood Rd.' — this OSM record covers only the Turner Road brewpub location; ensure the Boxwood Rd. brewery is not a duplicate or a separate candidate requiring its own listing.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, publicly accessible restaurant and craft brewpub with a full food menu, to-go options, and confirmed operating hours. Clear value for touring cyclists seeking a sit-down meal or resupply stop in Nanaimo.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes Crunchy Vegan Tacos, Peanut Tofu Rice Bowl, Roasted Mushroom Ravioli, Longwood Veggie Burger, and Roast Vegetable Flatbread. No GF labelling found on website

Wi-Fi.detail: Brewer's Dining Room (third-floor private event space) explicitly listed as having 'free Wi-Fi'; availability in the general pub/restaurant area is not stated

wow_evidence: award-winning core beers alongside rotating seasonal taps, all brewed on-site
